title: Verified OIDC token without (or with empty) agencies claim gets company-wide data
reproduction: Sign a valid JWT with role=manager and no agencies claim; GET /api/v1/bi/overview and POST /copilot/query
root_cause: scopedAgency() returned undefined (= no filter) whenever the principal did not have exactly one agency
fix: scopedAgencies() fails closed for empty scope

title: Multi-agency user requesting 'all' sees every agency
reproduction: JWT agencies=[Tunis Centre,Sfax]; GET /bi/overview?agency=all
expected: Only Tunis Centre + Sfax (4 fixture invoices)
actual_before_fix: All 6 invoices incl. Sousse; Sousse appears in copilot tables
fix: Scope returned as explicit agency list and applied by services

title: BI date filters from/to ignored (documented in API_DOCUMENTATION.md)
reproduction: GET /bi/overview?from=2025-02-01&to=2025-02-28
root_cause: Route only read agency; no query validation
fix: Zod-validated agency/from/to (real calendar dates; from<=to) passed to services

title: Malformed or oversized JSON returns 500 INTERNAL_ERROR
reproduction: POST /copilot/query with body '{"question": ' or a 300 KB body
root_cause: Error handler mapped every non-multer error to 500
fix: body-parser error types mapped to 400/413; other 4xx preserved

title: Customer-payment questions refused as HR data
reproduction: POST /copilot/query 'Quels clients ont des paiements en retard ?'
fix: Accent-normalised word-boundary HR guard

title: Out-of-domain questions answered with the company margin figure
reproduction: 'Quelle sera la météo à Paris demain ?' / 'Quel fournisseur livre en retard ?'
actual_before_fix: status=ok with a margin figure and 17k sources
fix: Explicit unsupported topics + 'none' intent returns a refusal

title: Agency named in the question ignored
reproduction: dev-commercial-tunis: 'Quel est le chiffre d'affaires de Sfax ?'; admin same question
expected: Denied for Tunis user; Sfax-only figures for admin
actual_before_fix: Tunis user got a 'comparison' of Tunis data; admin got all agencies
root_cause: Agency keywords only selected a template
fix: Agency mentions resolved and intersected with the principal scope (deny outside scope)

title: Approval allowed when the configured OCR returned an incomplete or inconsistent extraction
reproduction: Upload with a provider returning missingFields; POST /documents/:id/approve
root_cause: Gate only checked ocr.name === 'disabled'; extraction never persisted
fix: Extraction persisted; approval requires complete extraction + invoice validation rules (totals/VAT/lines)

title: OCR failure leaves an orphan 'needs_review' record and deletes the file
reproduction: Upload with an OCR provider that throws
expected: 502 OCR_FAILED; document status=failed; file kept for retry
root_cause: OCR call inside the createDocument try/catch
fix: OCR failure handled separately

title: Re-uploading the same file is not detected (500 on PostgreSQL)
reproduction: Upload identical bytes twice as the same user
actual_before_fix: 201 twice (MemoryStore); unique-index violation -> 500 on PostgreSQL (code inspection - PG not executed)
fix: findDocumentByHash before storing

title: Upload into a foreign agency returns 400 instead of 403
reproduction: dev-manager-sfax uploads with agency=Tunis Centre
fix: Distinct handling

title: A document can be approved repeatedly
reproduction: Approve the same document twice
fix: Approval requires status needs_review

title: Unknown /api routes answer with Express HTML instead of the JSON error envelope
reproduction: GET /api/v1/does-not-exist
fix: JSON 404 handler under /api

title: Unresolved named entity silently answered with company-wide figures (found by held-out set v1)
reproduction: 'Quel est le CA de Sfx ?' / 'Le CA de Monastir ?' / 'Quelle marge avec SOTUVER ?'
actual_before_fix: Company-wide revenue/margin presented as the answer
root_cause: Unrecognised names ignored by keyword router
fix: Entity guard + every numeric answer states its scope and period

title: Receivables paraphrases routed to top-customers; ageing answered with a total (held-out v1)
reproduction: 'Quel montant nos clients nous doivent-ils encore ?' / 'créances de plus de 90 jours'
fix: Receivables vocabulary + explicit ageing refusal

title: Keyword router misroutes unseen paraphrases (held-out v2: 11/15)
reproduction: See reports/COPILOT_EVALUATION.md (V05 V12 V14 V15)
fix: The 4 observed cases were later patched by an external (non-QA) edit; generalisation not re-measured on fresh data

title: Copilot answer card always showed hardcoded financial figures under real answers and errors
reproduction: Ask any question (or make the API fail) in AI Copilot
actual_before_fix: 'Marge février 2025 24,4 %', 'CA février 428 650 DT' and a factor table on every answer
root_cause: Static demo markup left in ChatAnswer
fix: Card now renders answer.table; verified by E2E

title: E2E suite recorded as 30/30 but was not reproducible on another day or checkout
reproduction: Run npm run test:e2e from a clean checkout
expected: A deterministic 30/30 from the documented command
actual_before_fix: Assertions targeted the 6-row fixture and relied on the current calendar day (start/end-of-month)
root_cause: E2E webServer started the server without the SQLite database and the config used an obsolete env var
fix: The suite seeds a pinned copy of the ERP database (tests/e2e/support/erp-db.ts) and asserts the June-2026 KPIs

title: BI period selector not wired; label '01 jan. — 28 fév. 2025' displayed all-dates data
reproduction: Select 'Février 2025' in BI 360
actual_before_fix: No request; values unchanged (61 921.512 incl. Dec 2024)
fix: Period state passed as from/to; 'Toutes les dates' option added
regression_test: e2e 'the period filter restricts the KPIs'

title: Duplicate React keys in management tables (console error)
reproduction: Navigate Ventes/Achats/Stocks/Finance
actual_before_fix: 'Encountered two children with the same key'
fix: Cells keyed by column index

title: Hardcoded 'Stock dormant 54 120 DT' KPI and fabricated '0 %' deltas beside API KPIs
reproduction: Open BI 360
expected: Only computed figures; uncomputed KPI labelled as such
fix: 'Non calculé' + neutral deltas; margin % shows 'non définie' when revenue is 0
regression_test: e2e 'no KPI card displays a hardcoded figure'

title: 'Exporter le rapport' did nothing
reproduction: Click the button
fix: CSV export of the displayed KPIs and filters

title: No mobile layout: body min-width 1180px clipped content; buttons unreachable at 412 px
reproduction: Open the app on a 412 px viewport
actual_before_fix: Content clipped by overflow; export/upload unreachable
fix: Responsive rules <=900 px (top nav; single column; scrollable tables)
regression_test: e2e mobile project (15 tests) + strengthened layout test

title: OCR history tab showed a static placeholder and the approve modal claimed fabricated ERP values
reproduction: Open Smart OCR, import a file, click Historique; then confirm the approve modal
expected: A real list of imported documents; modal names the uploaded file
actual_before_fix: Static 'Aucun historique disponible' text; modal always said 'STE NOUR EQUIPEMENT ... 3 486
fix: Prototype markup with no API call and hardcoded strings
regression_test: GET /api/v1/documents (agency-scoped, store-backed) with api.documents(); history renders real rows and opens any document; modal is driven by uploadResult
fixed_in: tests/e2e/app.spec.ts 'the history lists real imports'; server/app.test.ts documents list scope

title: Static demo panels still show hardcoded business figures without a demo label
reproduction: Dashboard, BI 360 (alerts, chart, agency table, stock structure), Ventes/Achats/Stocks/Finance
fix: Partially addressed: the Smart OCR panels (review placeholder
fixed_in: approve modal) are now wired to the API (BUG-034); the dashboard/BI/management demo panels remain and still require a product decision (remove vs. wire to API)

title: KPI and stat cards round money to whole dinars (millime precision lost)
reproduction: Open BI 360 and read 'Chiffre d'affaires HT'
expected: Full 3-decimal amount matching the API and the CSV export
root_cause: dt() used the integer formatter while the API contract and export use 3 decimals
fix: dt() switched to fmt3 (millime precision)
regression_test: tests/e2e/app.spec.ts BI 360 KPIs (fail before the fix)

title: No authentication flow in the frontend; API client falls back to the 'dev-admin' token; upload agency hardcoded
reproduction: Inspect src/api.ts
expected: OIDC login and token handling; agency chosen by the user
root_cause: OIDC integration not built (no IdP available)
fix: Not fixed: requires the ERP identity provider

title: Cancelled documents counted in revenue
reproduction: Synthetic dataset (208 cancelled invoices)
root_cause: Fact model had no document status
fix: Status in fact rows; only posted documents aggregated

title: Receivables ignored partial payments; credit notes and VAT
reproduction: Synthetic dataset
root_cause: Receivables = HT revenue of rows flagged unpaid (boolean)
fix: Explicit per-invoice outstanding (TTC) model; overdue exposed

title: Missing cost could only be stored as 0 (inflates margin)
reproduction: bi-anomalies MISSING_COST
expected: Row excluded from margin and counted (missingCostRecords)
fix: cost: number|null; marginCoverage reported

title: Margin % reported 0 when revenue is 0
reproduction: Empty period
fix: null returned; UI shows 'non définie'

title: Binary floating-point money sums
reproduction: Ten rows of 0.100 TND
fix: Integer millime accumulation

title: recordCount counted fact rows instead of documents
reproduction: Synthetic dataset (multi-line invoices)
fix: Distinct invoiceId count

title: Customers and products grouped by display name: homonyms merged
reproduction: Synthetic dataset has 5 shared customer names (10 customers) and 8 duplicate product names
expected: One ranking line per customer/product id
actual_before_fix: Distinct customers summed into one line (masked in validation because the QA oracle made the same assumption)
fix: Group by customerId/productId when provided; label kept for display; oracle corrected
regression_test: defects.test.ts BUG-031 (verified to fail without the fix)
